output.explanation:
The central tree retains the five functional boundaries while shrinking the seed from 113 lines/8,960 characters to 77 lines/6,013 characters: reductions of 31.9% and 32.9%. Five peripheral trees expand pinned push resolution, workflow lifetime, capture/mutation, review recovery, and split persistence. M = modular structure, C = calls, O = ownership, D = data dependency. Tree nesting groups concepts; it does not imply execution order unless stated. Edges attach to specific concept lines, using 1-based line numbers. Positions account for measured text dimensions and leave gaps.

Evidence is limited to the supplied point, seed, and six pinned source texts. Push details come from pushIntegrationService.ts and gitPushSource.ts; workflow ownership from diffSessionWorkflowService.ts; capture, mutation, review, and acceptance from changeSessionService.ts; persistence and validation from changeSessionRecords.ts and diagramChangeSession.ts. Added details absent from the seed include replay preceding push enablement checks, Git execution settings, endpoint comparison with empty commit lists, separate API receipt queues, four-preview batches, manifest token contents, and hunk-context validation.

Corrections: capture skips unrelated repository documents before requesting snapshots; it rejects a repository mismatch detected after snapshotting. The service performs final validation after runAgentWorkflow returns, rather than treating validation as another agent step. History/tree/migration edits initially set draft, but an explicit ready status in the same update revalidates and can finish ready. Existing push deliveries can replay before enablement checks, which govern new generation. The public boundaries now include connections and request, omitted from the seed.

Uncertainty: imported workflow definitions, DiffSessionTools, catalog publication, and immutable-record helpers are not supplied. Their internal scheduling, transaction guarantees, and persistence mechanics cannot be independently established here. The diagrams show observed calls, arguments, checks, and receipt recovery; they do not claim verified catalog atomicity. The workflow source identifies analyze/materialize stage names, while the exact step definition remains imported.

Git Change Proposals
|-- [M] Push intake: PushIntegrationService -> PushSource + PushWorkflow + store
|   |-- Public: connections, connect, receive, get, generations
|   |-- [C] receive -> decode event -> ID from connectionId + eventId
|   |   |-- Matching replay shares pending work or returns stored generation
|   |   `-- New event -> create generation -> classify push
|   |       |-- Non-branch, deletion, unchanged endpoint, or equal trees -> skipped
|   |       `-- Net change -> workflow.start(pinned context, generation ID)
|   |-- [M] GitPushSource exposes validateConnection + resolve; Git stays internal
|   |   `-- Match registered checkout identity; fetch missing endpoint commits
|   `-- [D] Pinned before/after determine commits, ancestry kind, and tree difference
|       `-- New branch uses empty tree; branch HEAD is not an input
|-- [M] Agent orchestration: DiffSessionWorkflowService
|   |-- Public: start, get, cancel, dispose; depends on changes, agent, runtime, store
|   |-- Request chooses baseline session OR repository/commit context
|   |   `-- Request ID identifies run; conflicting replay rejects; starts share work
|   |-- [C] start -> begin -> background execute
|   |   |-- capture -> require pinned context + hunks; persist context and prompts
|   |   |-- Open runtime with DiffSessionTools and captured source reader
|   |   |-- runAgentWorkflow invokes agent steps; service then validates result
|   |   |   `-- Proposal must belong to these tools and already have status ready
|   |   `-- Success -> completed, ready for review; acceptance remains separate
|   `-- [O] Service retains abort controllers and live runs until execution settles
|       |-- Failure -> failed; aborted execution -> cancelled
|       `-- Save artifacts, dispose session, save run; clear active/live entries
|-- [M] Proposal workspace: ChangeSessionService
|   |-- Public: capture/create, snapshot/descriptor, apply/createDocument, update, request
|   |-- Depends on project/repository catalog, CanvasSessionPort, session repository
|   |   `-- Private serialization, controller/history reconstruction, change derivation
|   |-- [D] Frozen capture supplies analysis inputs and isolated proposal documents
|   |   |-- Repository context -> Git hunks; settled representations -> saved baselines
|   |   |-- Selected live snapshots replace matching baselines; unrelated repos skipped
|   |   `-- Baseline session alternative reuses original baselines and pinned hunks
|   |-- [O] create clones capture into draft version 0; request signature guards replay
|   |   |-- Existing documents retain baseline, saved revision ID, and proposed copy
|   |   `-- New documents have null baseline; canonical history owns undo/redo
|   |-- [C] apply -> controller.applyUpdate -> record -> refreshChanges
|   |   |-- Edit proposed state at document version; retain snapshot + history
|   |   `-- Serialized mutation increments session version; saves changed docs + receipt
|   |-- [D] Review changes derive from baseline versus proposed state
|   |   |-- No baseline: type 3; revision review/selection differences: type 1
|   |   |-- Diagram display or incident-edge differences: existing type 1, added type 2
|   |   `-- Stable IDs preserve annotations; prior type 4 survives regenerated type 1
|   `-- update checks session version; changes history, DiffTree, annotations, status
|       |-- History/tree/migration edits set draft; final explicit ready revalidates
|       `-- Annotate all generated changes exactly once; targets fixed, types 1 <-> 4
|-- [M] Review and acceptance: ChangeSessionService + validators + project catalog
|   |-- Read boundary: list, get, preview, readDiffTree, readTreemaps
|   |   |-- Summary omits bodies/history/replay receipts; preview restores one pair
|   |   |-- DiffTree mappings select captured hunks; unknown explicit hunk IDs reject
|   |   `-- [D] Treemaps combine stored DiffTree + previews at one checked version
|   |-- Ready requires nonempty changes, valid optional DiffTree, valid migrations
|   |   |-- Repository ownership agrees; dependsOn references exist and are acyclic
|   |   `-- Valid edge anchors; added diagrams connect from a baseline diagram
|   `-- [C] accept(requestId, expectedVersion), serialized per session
|       |-- Existing acceptance replays only for the same request and proposal version
|       |-- Require expected version + ready status; revalidate; select affected docs
|       |-- Check matching live originals in every project workspace against baseline
|       |   `-- Changed document state or name -> conflict; create a new proposal
|       |-- Call catalog.acceptCanvasChanges with proposals and revision expectations
|       |   `-- Also supply histories, change IDs, request ID, and session version
|       `-- [O] Catalog receipt drives accepted status and interrupted-write recovery
|           `-- finishAcceptance sets version = receipt.sessionVersion + 1
`-- [M] Durable proposal records: ChangeSessionRecords
    |-- Public: list/read summaries, scoped preview/DiffTree, full read, write
    |   `-- Domain validators check identity, acceptance consistency, context, state
    |-- [O] Private format-2 manifest references immutable records
    |   |-- Summary, document references, receipt-map reference, optional DiffTree
    |   |-- Documents split metadata, baseline, proposal, history header/checkpoints
    |   `-- DiagramPersistence delegates diagram revision storage
    |-- [C] write -> serialize by project/session -> check optional manifest token
    |   |-- Store supplied records; reuse unchanged references; require complete docs
    |   `-- Require matching DiffTree summary/data -> publishJson(manifest) -> token
    `-- [D] Read scope determines restoration cost
        |-- Summary reads metadata; preview restores baseline + proposal
        |-- Full read also restores history and receipts; document callers get clones
        `-- Legacy records migrate on manifest demand; two document caches cap at 16

Pinned push resolution and delivery replay
|-- [C] receive checks pending/stored event before enablement flags
|   |-- Replay compares the entire decoded event; changed payload conflicts
|   |-- New work requires connection.enabled and application enablement
|   `-- Recheck pending after reads; createGeneration arbitrates stored identity
|-- [M] connect keeps repositoryId + external identity immutable
|   `-- validateConnection checks the local checkout, then saves connection
|-- [C] GitPushSource.resolve uses an identity-matching registered checkout
|   |-- credentialEnv configured but missing -> fail before Git execution
|   |-- Git disables prompts, replacement objects, and HTTP redirects
|   |   `-- Optional bearer header is configured for connection.remoteUrl
|   |-- Check endpoint SHAs as commits; fetch missing SHAs and check again
|   |   `-- Fetch uses --no-tags and --no-write-fetch-head
|   `-- Reject shallow clone or more than 2000 discovered commits
|-- [D] Commit list, push kind, and content delta answer different questions
|   |-- rev-list --reverse --topo-order after ^before -> commit list
|   |   `-- New branch omits ^before; advertised commit list is not trusted
|   |-- before ancestor of after -> update; ancestry exit code 1 -> force-push
|   |   `-- Other ancestry errors propagate; absent before -> new-branch
|   `-- Compare endpoint tree IDs; absent before -> empty tree
|       `-- Empty-tree hash uses SHA-256 for 64-character IDs, otherwise SHA-1
`-- [C] Net tree change starts workflow with head=after, comparisonBase=before
    |-- commits can be empty; request schema permits endpoint comparison
    `-- get refreshes only stored running generations with workflowRunId

Workflow run ownership and completion
|-- [M] start requires AI enabled and validates a strict request
|   `-- Run ID hashes requestId; stored request must exactly match replay
|-- [O] starts owns pending begin promises; active owns AbortControllers
|   |-- live retains mutable run while execute runs in background
|   `-- begin returns a clone; execute finalizer removes active/live entries
|-- [C] execute captures before opening an agent session
|   |-- Require capture.context and nonempty hunks; then check abort signal
|   |-- Store context/prompts; sourceReader is constructed from capture
|   `-- DiffSessionTools callback records proposal ID and saves the run
|-- [C] Workflow callback runs each requested step through session.runStep
|   |-- Stage is typed analyze/materialize; workflow definition is imported
|   |-- Save request before execution; save response after execution
|   `-- Save transcript and accumulated metrics after each step
|-- [C] After runAgentWorkflow returns, service sets stage=validate
|   `-- changes.get(result ID) -> own ready proposal required -> completed
|-- [O] cancel signals abort; dispose aborts all active runs + disposes runtime
|   |-- Cancellation status is assigned when execute handles the abort/error
|   `-- Finally attempts transcript/metrics, then session disposal and run save
`-- [C] get reads live clone or stored run
    `-- Running with no local active/start entry -> reported interrupted
        `-- get itself does not persist that status or restart execution

Capture inputs and isolated proposal mutation
|-- [D] capture resolves context and captures hunks
|   |-- No commits and comparisonBase undefined -> empty hunk list
|   `-- Explicit comparisonBase can capture hunks even with zero commits
|-- [D] Settled representations are filtered by selected repository
|   `-- Saved revision becomes baseline; proposed copy starts equal
|-- [C] Live selection filters project and optional canvasId
|   |-- Unknown requested canvas rejects; multiple canvases need canvasId
|   |-- Before snapshot: unrelated repository documents are skipped
|   |-- After snapshot: repository mismatch rejects changed capture context
|   `-- Import returned revisions; retain snapshot revision/version and name
|-- [D] baselineChangeSessionId supplies its own complete Git context
|   |-- Reject simultaneous repository/commit/head/canvas/comparison inputs
|   `-- Keep only documents with baselines; clone originals, fork fresh history
|       `-- Exclude old proposal-only canvases; require at least one original
|-- [O] create clones captured documents; create receipt guards signature
|   `-- Signature includes capture hash when caller supplied capture
|-- [C] mutate serializes per session and checks request receipt first
|   |-- Matching receipt replays before editability and version checks
|   |-- Reject new mutations on accepted/archived or at 2000 receipt entries
|   `-- Save docs whose versions changed, new receipt, and changed DiffTree
|-- [C] request wraps bound API work in a separate api:session queue
|   |-- api:requestId receipt guards replay; execute runs before receipt write
|   `-- Receipt write uses session queue without incrementing session version
`-- [O] Controller imports legacy past/proposed/reversed-future once
    |-- Preserve nodeOrigins; reconstruct history head, past, future
    `-- record retains canonical history and clears legacy past/future arrays

Review consistency and acceptance recovery
|-- [D] readTreemaps captures summary + stored DiffTree
|   |-- Fetch document previews in batches of four
|   |-- Check each effective preview version and final effective summary
|   `-- Mismatch -> VERSION_CONFLICT; matching supplied version -> null
|-- [D] readDiffTree explicit hunkIds override node-derived hunk selection
|   `-- Return paged hunks, optional patches, and unmapped node IDs
|-- [C] validateReady checks change dependency IDs with DFS
|   |-- Unknown target or cycle rejects; it does not execute prerequisites
|   `-- Type 2 needs incoming edge whose source resolves in baseline scene
|       `-- Source owner may be new; containing diagram must already exist
|-- [C] accept chooses documents named by generated changes
|   |-- Match live documents by document ID OR representation ID
|   |-- Compare document state + name only where captured baseline exists
|   `-- Send expectedRevisionId to catalog with proposed document/history
|-- [O] Catalog acceptance receipt survives a later session-write failure
|   |-- list projects ready -> accepted and hides archived sessions
|   |-- preview/effectiveSummary project acceptance for the read generation
|   |-- get repairs a ready full record through finishAcceptance
|   `-- Receipt sessionVersion must equal the saved proposal version
`-- [C] accept re-entry calls get before checking acceptance replay
    |-- Same requestId + original expectedVersion -> return accepted summary
    `-- Different request or version -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT

Split storage boundaries and validation
|-- [O] Manifest retains references; document bodies are immutable records
|   |-- Receipt map holds individual receipt references
|   |-- History header excludes snapshots; checkpoints have separate refs
|   `-- Queues are module-wide, keyed by manifest path
|-- [C] write checks optional expected token inside publication queue
|   |-- Token is JSON.stringify(manifest), not just session version
|   |-- Reuse prior refs; prune documents absent from new summary
|   |-- Merge supplied receipts into previous receipt-reference map
|   `-- Reuse prior DiffTree only if its summary remains unchanged
|-- [D] restoreDiffTree validates structure, summary equality, hunk context
|   |-- Every hunk must match session repository
|   |-- comparisonBase defined: hunk.commit=head and hunk.parent=base
|   `-- Otherwise: hunk.commit must belong to selected commits
|-- [D] Preview cache and validated-document cache key by immutable ref
|   |-- Each holds at most 16 entries; oldest insertion evicted
|   `-- Return cloned documents so callers cannot mutate cached documents
`-- [C] Legacy summary read uses an opened file and generation stamp
    |-- Stamp includes inode, size, nanosecond mtime and ctime
    |-- Handle closes in finally; cache avoids restoring document histories
    `-- Manifest demand migrates legacy records by splitting stored refs
